---
applyTo: "**/*.html,**/*.css,**/*.js"
---

# HTML/CSS Instructions

- Use semantic HTML first and keep heading hierarchy coherent.
- Choose one CSS naming strategy per project - BEM or utility-first.
- Use CSS custom properties for tokens, mobile-first layout, and visible focus states.
- No `var`, prefer `const`, use event delegation, and never use unsafe `innerHTML` for user content.
- Follow `.claude/conventions/accessibility-style.md` for keyboard, focus, labelling, and contrast rules.
- Read `.claude/conventions/html-css-style.md` for the complete style guide.
